title: Ind-smoothness under compatible field identifications
statement: Let $k\to K$ be a separable extension of fields [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension], $R\to S$ a homomorphism of commutative rings, and $e_R:R\simeq k$, $e_S:S\simeq K$ ring isomorphisms such that $e_S(r\cdot1)=\operatorname{algebraMap}_{k,K}(e_R(r))$ for all $r\in R$. Assume $k,R$ lie in universe $u$, $K$ in universe $w$, and $S$ in universe $\max(u,v,w)$. Then $S$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras], with carriers and index category in universe $\max(u,v,w)$ and its universal property in commutative $R$-algebras.

proof.text: The finitely generated smooth k-subalgebras of K are a nonempty directed cover.

Pull back their k-scalar actions along e_R and lift their carriers to the joint universe. Inclusions commute with the R-action. Smoothness follows by composing the smooth isomorphism e_R with the smooth map from k to each lifted subalgebra.

Lift the directed indexing preorder as well. The inclusion cocone to ULift K is a colimit in types: the cover gives surjectivity, and injective inclusions detect equality. Reflect this colimit to commutative rings. Its ring descents commute with the R-action, checked on constants from one nonempty stage, so it is an R-algebra colimit.
The compatibility hypothesis makes e_S followed by ULift.up an R-algebra equivalence. Transport the ind-smooth presentation along the inverse equivalence.

theorem ind_smooth_of_separable_ringEquivs
    {k : Type u} {K : Type w} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {R : Type u} {S : Type (max u v w)}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (hsep : IsSeparableExtension k K) (eR : R ≃+* k) (eS : S ≃+* K)
    (hcompat : ∀ r : R, eS (algebraMap R S r) = algebraMap k K (eR r)) :
    ObjectProperty.ind.{max u v w}
      (fun B : CommAlgCat.{max u v w} R ↦ Smooth R B) (CommAlgCat.of R S)
